findings.effect: Parsed manifest may change before initial snapshot.
findings.fix: Re-read manifest bytes through held-descriptor reader and compare original digest before returning.

findings.effect: Hashed package files can contain undeclared installed dependencies without license review.
findings.fix: Compare actual scoped/nested package-root inventory against declared dependency paths.

findings.effect: WinSW license bytes are not tied to existing trusted pin.
findings.fix: Require bounded actual WinSW license digest against serviceRuntime.licenseSha256.

findings.effect: Concurrent local junction replacement can create outside directories before subsequent rejection.
findings.next: Focused native ownership-before-directory-create hardening; current read-only collector refuses changed output and never deletes partial trees.

findings.effect: Duplicate health required-suite row, no weakened validation.
